religiousDataBindings._note: Energy-parity data tank. Energy.json binds subsystems to real DATA CUSTODIANS (EIA, FRED) and per-name sector equities (DUK, NEE, FSLR...). Religious identity = BELIEF, INSTITUTIONS, PRACTICE, AFFILIATION, FREEDOM, and DISAFFILIATION — it has NO tradable equities, so it binds to real religion-data custodians (with API/series identifiers) and to real faith INSTITUTIONS classified by governance role, NOT financial tickers. The per-node activations[].companies arrays are RETAINED for engine compatibility; these bindings ADD the primary measurement and authority layer. Couplings to population (affiliation demographics), governance (religious-freedom policy), and culture (secular content/scenes) are flagged as cross-domain couplings, NOT part of religion identity. Never fabricate tickers or data; no energy oil/gas/grid content applies.

dataCustodians.name: Pew Research Center — Religion & Public Life
dataCustodians.endpoint: pewresearch.org/religion (Religious Landscape Study; Global Restrictions on Religion)
dataCustodians.series_notes: unaffiliated_pct = share of 'nones'; weekly_attendance_pct = self-reported weekly service attendance; government_restrictions_index (GRI) and social_hostilities_index (SHI) score state and societal limits on religion

dataCustodians.name: Association of Religion Data Archives
dataCustodians.endpoint: thearda.com (US Religion Census; Religion & State data)
dataCustodians.series_notes: US Religion Census adherence and congregation counts by tradition and county; Religion-and-State establishment/regulation/discrimination scores

dataCustodians.name: Gallup
dataCustodians.series_notes: Long-run polling on attendance, confidence in organized religion, and salience of religion in daily life

dataCustodians.name: Public Religion Research Institute
dataCustodians.series_notes: Inter-religious favorability, disaffiliation by cohort, religious-nationalism adherence, and faith-group voting patterns

dataCustodians.name: World Values Survey
dataCustodians.series_notes: Cross-national waves measuring religiosity, belief intensity, and the traditional-vs-secular values dimension (Inglehart-Welzel)
dataCustodians.access: free, registered data download (no commercial key)

dataCustodians.name: U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom
dataCustodians.series_notes: Country of Particular Concern (CPC) and Special Watch List (SWL) designations; per-country religious-freedom conditions and violation tracking

institutions._note: Real faith institutions and research bodies, classified by governance/authority role rather than financial tradability. These are the doctrinal/administrative/custodial authorities behind religious identity. governance_role replaces energy's binding_strength price-discovery model.

crossDomainCouplings._note: Religion COUPLES to these domains but they are NOT religion identity. Population owns affiliation demographics; governance owns religious-freedom policy; culture owns secular content/scenes/movements.
crossDomainCouplings.population: Religious affiliation demographics (the demographic baseline of who affiliates)
crossDomainCouplings.governance: Religious-freedom policy & church-state law (the policy frame)
crossDomainCouplings.culture: Secular content, scenes, and humanist movements (the non-faith cultural field)
